protect.title: Protect your progress
protect.intro.vk: Your rating, level and history are kept on the server, and this installation's key opens them. A reinstall or a new phone starts a new profile unless you link VK ID or save recovery codes. Progress follows the VK-linked account: sign in with the same VK ID on any device to keep playing it.
protect.intro.codes: Your rating, level and history are kept on the server, and this installation's key opens them. A reinstall or a new phone starts a new profile unless you save recovery codes.
protect.status.unprotected: Not protected yet: only this installation can open your profile.
protect.profile.unknown: Account protection: open Protect progress to check.
protect.codes.title: Your recovery codes
protect.codes.notice: Write them down or take a screenshot, and keep them private. Each code works once, on any device: Profile → Link or recover account → Enter a recovery code. They are not shown again.
protect.replace_warning: New codes replace your unused codes; the old ones stop working. Press again to confirm.
protect.recover_hint: Lost a device? On the new one: Profile → Link or recover account.
protect.recovery.entry: Type or paste one of your saved recovery codes. Each code works once.
protect.prompt.vk: Protect your progress: link VK ID or save a recovery code.
protect.prompt.codes: Protect your progress: save a recovery code.
protect.error.stopped: The account request stopped. Try again.
